head: codex/13-skip-optional-workspace-coverage
title: [CI][WP-02A] Skip unselected workspace coverage producers
body:
Closes #13

## Summary
- adds explicit Runtime, fast-workspace, and full-workspace coverage producer selectors
- routes the PR #9 Runtime + Observatory surface to Runtime-only coverage
- skips unselected heavy producer jobs before checkout or tool installation
- verifies hosted/Spot producer results against a fail-closed route matrix

## Validation
- `bash adl/tools/test_ci_path_policy.sh`: PASS
- `bash adl/tools/test_ci_runtime_contracts.sh`: PASS
- `bash adl/tools/test_verify_coverage_producer_results.sh`: PASS
- workflow YAML parse and `git diff --check`: PASS

## Review
- independent exact-head review approved commit `241a39d0711a83965d481e2ed0d774fca37ab81f` with no P0-P3 findings

## Deferred live proof
- the PR Actions canary must show Runtime coverage plus both required aggregates succeed while both full-workspace shards remain GitHub-skipped with no runner start
